_note: The head's mouth (firmware/head_esp32, its simulator, pepin.head_server, the face tools): one table. Every expression is a full set of the parameters below, and the renderer tweens each parameter on its own, so any expression turns into any other. An expression's id on the wire ('E' frames) is its index in `expressions`, so append, never reorder. An expression: `brief` (at most six words: the brain's list, pepin.face.face_lines), `params` (the rest at their defaults), `colors` (any of the face's elements, the rest at the `colors` block's defaults), `like` (an earlier expression's params, colors and style blocks under its own), `variants` (up to three other expressions: each time it is asked for, the firmware shows it or one of them at random; the status still names the one asked for), `effects` (heart: a heart floats up from the mouth, timing.heart_s, once each time it is shown; z: a "z" floats up and away every timing.z_every_s while it shows, each engine drawing its own glyph) and a block per later style (`rose`, `manga`, `anime`: its look in that style, `params` over its own numbers, `colors` over that style's palette, `effects` in place of its own; without a block the style draws the expression's numbers in its palette). The face has six STYLES (`style`, `styles`): the same ids and names drawn six ways; the head server sends the style with the 'C' config, so a switch is live (no rebuild). The anime style is drawn by the shape-keyframe engine (`engine` shapes): its mouths are the SVGs in config/anime, one per expression and talk key, and the only numbers it takes from an expression are breathe, drift, wave/wave_n/wave_speed, wag, and cheeks and stripes (its overlays: config/<style>/cheeks_rest.svg and stripes_rest.svg drawn over any look at those opacities). After an edit: uv run python -m pepin.face --write (regenerates firmware/head_esp32/src/face_table.h, sim/face_table.js, src/anime_table.h and sim/anime_table.js; the unit tests refuse stale copies).

screen.note: landscape, the mouth under the stereo camera; rotation is LovyanGFX's setRotation (1 or 3 turns it upside down)

geometry.note: pixels of a 320x170 screen: what each parameter at 1.0 means. speech_open: the opening a full 'M' level adds; speech_narrow: the share of the width it takes away (a talking mouth narrows as it opens). wag_hz: the tongue's wag (the wag parameter). tongue_w_px: the tongue's width; cheek_*: the blush's ellipses, their centres cheek_x_px either side of the screen's middle and cheek_y_px above it; dimple_px: the cheek fold's radius beyond the line's edge; moustache_*: its width, its height at 1, its gap above the upper lip and a rim in the line's colour round it (0: none; pure black is the screen's own background, so the moustache is the darkest grey that still shows); fang_w_px: a fang's half width at its root; heart_px: the kiss's heart's size, heart_rise_px: how far it floats up; pucker_px: the kiss's pucker's height at 1 (a width under 0.2 scales it down: a small 'ε'); margin_px: the face keeps this far inside the screen (an opening that would reach past it is scaled down, the tongue and the drool shortened, the heart held in); hook_px: a corner hook's radius at 1; heart_lips_px: the heart-shaped mouth's height at 1; drool_px: the drool's length at 1, drool_at: where along the lower lip it hangs (a share of the half width, + right as seen); z_glyph_px: the sleeper's "z" at the end of its flight (it grows as it rises), z_glyph_rise_px: how far it floats up (the parametric styles' glyph; the anime engine draws its own). thick_min_px, thick_max_px, tooth_gap_px and tongue_w_px are the pepin style's: a style may set its own (styles)

colors.note: RGB, converted to RGB565 for the panel. lip, cavity, teeth, tongue, cheek, moustache, heart and shade (the lighter band at the bottom of an open mouth, the drool and the plump tongue's highlight: the later styles'; this style draws none) are the face's elements: an expression's `colors` overrides any of them (these are the defaults) and the firmware tweens them with the parameters; background, text and accent are the screen's and the info screen's

pepin.note: the cyan face of 2026-10: a thick glowing line on the black screen, the geometry's and colors' numbers as they stand

rose.note: the pepin shapes as line art on paper (2026-10-14 night, the first manga try: Artem: the same thing in another palette; kept as a style of its own): a thin dark-rose outline, a flat pink fill with a shade band, one white teeth band under a line, corner hooks on the smile lines, the '3' kiss, a filled heart for kiss_heart, a fang on sinister, the grey dumbbell for tired, a drool on sleepy

manga.note: the anime mouth drawn by the parametric engine (2026-10-14 night, the common anime mouth conventions bent into the one line): its own numbers, not the pepin curves. The shapes follow the standard guides (firmware/head_esp32/README.md cites them): an open mouth is the lower half of an inverted egg under a horizontal upper lip (`upper` 0: the top edge and the teeth stay put, the jaw drops), the teeth one white band along the top whose lower line curves down and stops short of the corners (teeth_span), the tongue one upward curve at the bottom from corner to corner (`patch`, patch_x 0), the inside darkest, the tongue lighter, the teeth white; a closed mouth a light curve, a smile a bigger one with the corners up (the hooks are the kaomoji conventions'); the sly/cat mouth a wave raised at the corners and the middle; the grin tilted with the upper lip raised and one sharp tooth on that side (`fang_at`, `fang_side`); the tongue out to the side of a tilted line, or hanging from the cat line (tease); the curious mouth a rounded rectangle with the top teeth slightly visible (listening); upset a series of waves (worried); surprised an O with teeth and tongue; sad opens with the emotion; the lip flap three drawings, closed, half open and open, cut on the speech (flap_shapes 3). On the cream card like rose (Artem 2026-10-15); the screen's black is one number here

anime.note: the anime mouths drawn after the common anime mouth conventions (2026-10-15), drawn by the shape-keyframe engine (firmware/head_esp32/src/face_anime.cpp, pepin.face_shapes): every expression is three SVGs in config/anime (NAME_rest, NAME_half, NAME_open), closed outlines per layer, morphed vertex by vertex. engine: shapes (the parametric numbers of this block are unused but flap_shapes, the talk cut's three drawings); shapes: the directory under config/; line_px: the outlines' width where an SVG gives none; talk_tween_ms: the tween between two talk drawings at a cut; drool_s: the drool drop's stretch period (the sleeper's z: timing z_s, z_every_s). The elements' colours: lip the outline, cavity the mouth's interior, shade the highlights and the drool, teeth, tongue, cheek the blush, moustache, heart. The cream card of the rose set as the ground

kawaii.note: the minimal kawaii mouths, drawn after the common kaomoji mouth conventions, the robot's default since 2026-10-15 (the guide firmware/head_esp32/KAWAII_STYLE.md), drawn by the shape engine from config/kawaii: tiny mouths under big eyes in one near-black line, the laughs rose inside with white outlined teeth, the quiet mouths rose ovals and rectangles, the slack mouths, the dots and the kiss's o dark inside by their kawaii blocks (tired, sleepy, thinking_flat, kiss, tease), the tongues rose and plain, pink cheeks, the tear light blue (shade), white paper. The palette is the guide's (2026-10-15 evening; the cocoa of the afternoon read old-fashioned). The drawings are drawn small (a 36 px u in a 3.5 px pen) and the screen shows them at scale 2.5 about their common centre (160, 70), the line 10 px (14 in the afternoon's proportion study read heavy and gloomy on the panel): scale and line_px are the knobs, the drawings stay. like anime: the engine, the talk cut and the drool period, and in every expression and gesture the anime block under the kawaii one (sleepy's z, the tongues' wag, the vampire's and the terminator's colours, the idle gestures in shape space)

comics.note: the comics mouths drawn after the classic-cartoon mouth conventions (2026-10-15, a proof of concept beside the anime set: the same 33 ids so the sets compare side by side), drawn by the shape-keyframe engine like anime (its talk cut, drool period and idle gestures); every expression is three SVGs in config/comics, firmware/head_esp32/COMICS_STYLE.md the pen. One 5 px ink line (line_px), the mouth's interior the same ink, white teeth with the gaps drawn as ink strokes, one red for the tongue, the kiss lips, the cheeks and the heart, a tear blue for the drool; white paper, not the cream card: the teeth are the paper's white and the black mouth is the screen's own black

styles.note: the face's styles, the firmware's Style enum and the 'C' config's byte in this block's order: pepin 0, rose 1, manga 2, anime 3, kawaii 4, comics 5. A style's `like` names an earlier style it starts from: its numbers, colours, engine and own keys (never its drawings' directory), in every expression and idle gesture that style's block under this style's own, and the idle gestures it plays; so a new drawn set registers as one entry here (like anime, shapes: its directory, its palette) plus the directory of its 100 SVGs. A shapes style's own numbers: shapes (the directory), line_px (the outline's width on the screen: the generator draws every outline this wide whatever the SVG says, a thinner stroke keeping the file's ratio to the outline), scale (the drawings enlarged about the set's common centre, pepin.face_shapes.centre_of; the strokes stay line_px; default 1), talk_tween_ms, drool_s. `style` names the one the head server sends with the 'C' config (live: {"cmd": "config", "style": "manga"} or `pepin.head_link style manga` switches it on the head without a rebuild; the simulator and preview.js have the same switch). A style: thick_min_px/thick_max_px (the line's thickness over `thick`), tooth_gap_px (0: the teeth one white band), tongue_w_px (the tongue's width), shade (the share of an open mouth's bottom in the shade colour), teeth_line_px (a line in the lip's colour under the teeth band), deco_line_px (an outline in the lip's colour round the tongue, the drool and the tongue patch), pucker_line (the kiss's '3' stroke as a share of a lobe's radius; 0: the mouth's own line), tongue_shine (the plump tongue's highlight, a share of its radius), patch_x (where the tongue patch's dome peaks along the mouth, -1..1; 0 the middle), teeth_span (how far the teeth band reaches towards the corners, a share of the half width), flap_shapes (0: the speech level opens the mouth continuously; 3: the anime lip flap, closed / half open / open, cut on the level), colors (the elements' defaults and the background in this style; the pepin style's are the colors block's)

width.note: the mouth's width, a share of the screen's

open.note: the opening at the middle, a share of max_open_px

smile.note: the corners lifted (+) or dropped (-), smile_px at 1

upper.note: the share of the opening above the mouth's line: 0 keeps the upper lip on the line (a D-shaped grin, the manga bowl)

corner_exp.note: the opening's profile: 1.2 a lens with pointed corners, 2 an ellipse, 8 a rounded rectangle

teeth.note: 0 none, 0.5 the upper row, 1 both rows meeting at the bite (clenched)

wave.note: a wave along the mouth, wave_px at 1: worried wobble or the zigzag

wave_speed.note: the wave crawls along the mouth, periods per second; at 0 a wave settles to its home phase (the cat's w reads only there)

asym.note: the right corner (as seen) up (+) and the left down, asym_px at 1

shift_x.note: the mouth moved sideways, shift_x_px at 1 (+ right as seen)

shift_y.note: the mouth moved down (+), shift_y_px at 1

breathe.note: a slow idle breath of the width and the opening (breathe_hz)

drift.note: a slow idle drift sideways (drift_hz), shift_x_px/3 at 1

bow.note: Cupid's bow: the upper lip dips at the middle, bow_px at 1 (puckered lips, a pout)

tongue.note: the tongue out under the mouth's line, tongue_px long at 1

tongue_x.note: where along the mouth the tongue comes out: -1 the left corner, 1 the right (as seen)

cheeks.note: the blush beside the mouth: pink ellipses with three strokes, their opacity

dimples.note: the cheek folds round the corners, an arc of dimple_px radius; 1 its full length

moustache.note: a short block moustache above the mouth, moustache_h_px high at 1

fangs.note: two fangs hanging from the upper lip (from the teeth band when there is one), fang_px long at 1

tongue_lean.note: the tongue's tip sideways, a share of its length (+ right as seen): a limp tongue hangs aside

pucker.note: the kiss: the lips pursed into a "3", pucker_px tall at 1, the mouth's line shrinking into it

hooks.note: corner hooks: the line's ends curl down (+) or up (-), an arc of hook_px radius at 1 (the manga convention's ticks)

heart_lips.note: the mouth drawn as a filled heart, heart_lips_px tall at 1, the mouth's line shrinking into it (the manga kiss_heart)

bulb.note: the opening's profile swells at the corners into round ends and thins in the middle: a dumbbell, lips pressed (the manga 'mm')

fang_side.note: which fangs: 0 both, -1 the left one only (as seen), 1 the right one only

drool.note: a drop of drool hanging from the lower lip at drool_at, drool_px long at 1

patch.note: the tongue patch inside an open mouth: a lighter dome rising from the bottom of the opening, this share of the opening's height at the dome's peak, its top one upward curve from corner to corner (the manga bowl)

wag.note: the tongue out wags: its tip sways sideways by this share of its half length at wag_hz

fang_at.note: the fangs' place either side of the middle, a share of the mouth's half width (0.42 the pepin vampire's; near 1 the corners; near 0 one tooth at the middle)

stripes.note: the shock's vertical stripes down one cheek, their opacity: the shape engine's overlay (config/<style>/stripes_rest.svg, as cheeks draws config/<style>/cheeks_rest.svg over any look); the parametric engine draws none

expressions.name: neutral
expressions.note: the resting mouth: a short, slightly lifted line; rose: its ends hooked down; manga: the short 'u' with its ends flicked up (the neutral lines), a bowl when it talks

expressions.name: smile
expressions.note: a closed smile, breathing a little deeper than the rest (the resting face); rose: the laughing line, its corners flicked up; manga: the hooked smile line, a bowl when it talks; kawaii: the round u (Artem 2026-10-15: the resting face), the wide u kept as smile_wide

expressions.name: happy
expressions.note: an open D-shaped smile with the upper teeth showing (arrived); rose: the open D with one white teeth band over the pink; manga: the tall bowl of the big laugh: a flat top with the white band, the tongue patch rising in it, breathing deep; kawaii: the rose laugh with one outlined tooth (Artem 2026-10-15), the toothless one kept as happy_plain

expressions.name: grin
expressions.note: a wide grin, the upper row of teeth; rose: the oval grin with the white band; manga: the wide shallow bowl with the band and the patch

expressions.name: clenched
expressions.note: a grin with clenched teeth: effort, awkwardness; rose: the lens full of teeth; manga: the lens of teeth

expressions.name: sad
expressions.note: the corners down (a goal failed); rose: the thin frown arc; manga: the downturned open mouth with the tongue patch

expressions.name: worried
expressions.note: a wobbly, slightly open frown; rose: the wobbly cloud of a sob; manga: the upset mouth of the guides, a series of waves, not symmetrical

expressions.name: surprised
expressions.note: an O; rose: a taller oval; manga: the tall oval with the teeth band at the top and the tongue patch at the bottom

expressions.name: thinking
expressions.note: a short skewed line off to the side, drifting (the LLM is working); each time it is asked for, the firmware shows it or one of its variants at random (Artem 2026-10-14: not always the corners-down look); rose: the smirk line with a hook; manga: a tiny slanted line with a hook

expressions.name: struggling
expressions.note: a crawling zigzag: a recovery, a slip, stuck; rose: the same crawl as a thin line; manga: the wavy line crawling (the neutral lines' wave)

expressions.name: flat
expressions.note: a dead-straight line: unimpressed, no comment; manga: the short flat line

expressions.name: sleepy
expressions.note: a small round mouth breathing slowly (the host is silent, the brain is away); rose: a small tilted bean with a drop of drool; manga: the rose bean, and a 'z' floats up and away every few seconds (Artem 2026-10-15: no drool); anime: the dumbbell, the z over it; kawaii: the dot of a doze (Artem 2026-10-15), no drool

expressions.name: focused
expressions.note: a short firm line (driving to a goal); manga: the short flat line, a touch firmer

expressions.name: listening
expressions.note: a small open, attentive mouth (someone speaks to the robot); rose: the small round mouth with a teeth band; manga: the guides' curious mouth, a rounded rectangle with the top teeth slightly visible; kawaii: the small rose laugh with one outlined tooth set aside (Artem 2026-10-15)

expressions.name: sinister
expressions.note: a wide lopsided grin with a sawtooth bite: the upper row of teeth over a dark mouth, the lip line a sharp zigzag (the evil laugh, the mischievous click; Artem 2026-10-13: a sinister smile with sharp teeth); appended, never reordered (the wire id is the index); rose: the fang grin, one fang on the left, no band; manga: the guides' malicious grin, tilted with the upper lip raised on one side, the band, one sharp tooth hanging from it on the raised side, no zigzag

expressions.name: kiss
expressions.note: the lips pursed into a pink "3" (Artem 2026-10-14: bow-shaped lips, as the kissing emoji); rose: the thin "3" glyph; manga: a plump "3"

expressions.name: kiss_heart
expressions.brief: blows a kiss, a heart flies
expressions.note: the kiss, and a heart leaves it to the side and up and fades (once each time it is shown); rose and manga: the mouth itself a filled heart, the heart flying off it

expressions.name: pout
expressions.note: small thick lips pushed out in a frown, a bow on top, the cheeks flushed (Artem 2026-10-14: sulking); rose and manga: the same small frown in their line (Artem 2026-10-15: the rose pout, no tooth)

expressions.name: thinking_flat
expressions.note: thinking without the dropped corners: a short, nearly straight line off to the side, drifting (one of thinking's variants); rose and manga: with a hook (Artem 2026-10-15: the rose shape, not the 'ε')

expressions.name: moustache
expressions.note: a short black moustache (the darkest grey the screen shows) over a narrow, nearly straight mouth (Artem 2026-10-14); manga: over a hooked short line

expressions.name: o_mouth
expressions.note: a small round O, smaller than surprised: ooh, uuh, wow; manga: the small oval with the tongue patch

expressions.name: vampire
expressions.note: a sly open smile in red, the mouth dark red inside, two white fangs hanging from the upper lip; rose: the same in a deeper rose; manga: the bowl with two long fangs, a deeper fill

expressions.name: terminator
expressions.note: a rectangular clenched grin in steel: grey lips, silver teeth, a red glow behind them; manga: the lens of teeth in steel

expressions.name: blush
expressions.note: a small wobbly mouth between pink hatched cheeks (the anime blush); manga: the guides' embarrassed mouth, slightly open, between the cheeks

expressions.name: tease
expressions.note: the teasing face: a short line off to the side, the tongue hanging out of it towards one end, wagging (2026-10-15 night, Artem on the robot: the `tongue` face's numbers and drawings in every style, taken over when that id went; its own, the wide smile with the whole tongue out of its middle, and kawaii's small open mouth the tongue filled, did not read as a stuck-out tongue); rose: the tongue outlined; manga: the guides' tongue-out face, a line tilted to one side with the plump tongue out of the raised side; anime and comics: the smile with the tongue out of its right corner; kawaii: the shallow smile with the tongue hanging from its middle

expressions.name: tired
expressions.note: a slack open mouth, the tongue hanging limp out of one side (Artem 2026-10-14: worn out); rose: the grey dumbbell, lips pressed into an 'mm'; manga: the lolling tongue, a slack small mouth with the plump tongue hanging out to one side (AnimeOutline's tongue-out; Artem 2026-10-15: not the dumbbell)

expressions.name: cat
expressions.note: the anime cat mouth: a w with a little peak in the middle (Artem 2026-10-14): the smile's corners up, a standing wave of one and a half periods for the two dips; rose and manga: the same line with its ends hooked up

expressions.name: cat_blush
expressions.note: the cat mouth between pink hatched cheeks

expressions.name: smile_wide
expressions.note: the smile's wide variant (2026-10-15: the kawaii smile of the morning, the wide u, kept when Artem chose the round u as the resting face; the book's pools draw it beside smile); the same look as smile in every other style

expressions.name: happy_plain
expressions.note: happy's variant without the tooth (2026-10-15: the kawaii laugh of the morning, kept when Artem chose the one-tooth laugh; the book's pools draw it beside happy); the same look as happy in every other style

expressions.name: angry
expressions.note: a tight downturned mouth of gritted teeth (Artem 2026-10-15; the brows are the eye rings' job): pepin and rose the clenched grin narrowed and turned down, manga the lens of teeth turned down, anime the lens of teeth with its ends down, comics the gritted grid turned down, kawaii the small pillow of teeth under an arch

expressions.name: shocked
expressions.note: a small tall rounded-rectangle mouth open in shock, the cheeks flushed, three vertical stripes down one cheek (Artem 2026-10-15): the stripes are the shape engine's overlay (stripes), the parametric styles draw the mouth and the cheeks alone; kawaii pink inside

goal_accepted.name: focused
goal_accepted.note: the goal server took a goal: held until the drive ends

goal_failed.name: sad
goal_failed.note: the drive ended ABORTED or was refused

listening.name: listening
listening.note: the voice loop hears an utterance, or a conversation is open and waits for the person

thinking.name: thinking
thinking.note: the LLM call is in flight

speaking.name: smile
speaking.note: the robot speaks: lip sync rides on top

brain_lost.name: sleepy
brain_lost.note: every brain lease lapsed (the laptop or the WiFi is gone)

stall_look.name: surprised
stall_look.note: the gaze's stall look turns the head to a blocker the lidar does not back

phantom_carved.name: grin
phantom_carved.note: the stall look found nothing there: the phantom is erased

obstacle_confirmed.name: worried
obstacle_confirmed.note: the stall look found a real thing in the way

vio_restart.name: struggling
vio_restart.note: OpenVINS diverged and its keeper restarted it

events.note: a moment by name (pepin.face_events senders, pepin.head_link.HeadClient.event): the expression, how long (null: until the source replaces or clears it), how strongly, and min_gap_s: the head server drops the same moment from the same source sooner than this after the last (default 0)

lipsync.note: pepin.audio_server's levels: the RMS of each window_s of the speech it plays, in dBFS, mapped linearly from floor_db (closed) to full_db (fully open) and sent as an 'M' level when that window reaches the speaker. start_latency_s: from the first chunk written to aplay to its first sound (an estimate: aplay's start plus the ALSA buffer, unmeasured); lead_s: sent this much earlier than that, for the mouth's own attack. The simulator maps its microphone and audio files the same way

idle.note: the face alive at rest (the firmware's FaceModel and sim/face.js): while one of `expressions` shows, every every_s (a random span between the two) one gesture, picked by weight, adds its params to the mouth over duration_s as a smooth bump (a mirror gesture flips its sign at random: a tilt either way). Never within settle_s of an expression change or of a speech level, and a gesture under way fades out over fade_s when one comes. enabled false: none. The gestures are parameter deltas, so every parametric style makes them; a gesture with `styles` plays in those styles only (the manga corner twitch and the tiny 'ε' the line shrinks into, the anime deep breath). In the anime style a gesture is its `anime` block, in shape space: dx, dy (px), sx, sy (a scale about the mouth's centre), tilt (px of y per px of x), curl (the corners down, px), and toward/amount (a morph toward an expression's rest keyframe, or a keyframe of its own in config/anime: eps)

timing.note: heart_s: the heart effect's flight; z_s, z_every_s: the sleeper's z (the z effect; each engine draws its own glyph), one flight and how often one leaves, from the mouth up and out; transition_ms: an expression's default tween; host_silent_s: the firmware falls asleep after this long without a frame from the board; mouth_*: the lip-sync level's smoothing, and how long a level stands without a fresh 'M' before it closes
